name: com.openugd.context
description: A composition root, not a framework. Describe singletons on a ContextBuilder; BuildAsync validates the entire graph before constructing anything, reports every problem at once with the file and line of each registration, constructs in dependency order, runs an Awake/Initialize boot ordered by dependency rank, and either returns a fully built Context or disposes everything it made and rethrows. Scoped by Lifetime, with no UnityEngine dependency: usable from a plain NUnit test, a console app, or a headless server build.

samples.description: A composition root from start to end: registrations, a ScriptableObject settings asset handed over with AddInstance, services booted in the Awake and Initialize phases, BuildAsync awaited from a MonoBehaviour entry point, and a scope that ends in OnDestroy so nothing survives play mode. Includes EditMode tests.

A root context for the game, a child context per level and per window: children see and shadow their parent's services, dispose only their own, and end with their parent even on a scope of their own. Plain C# with a runner component; includes EditMode tests.

Several modules contributing to one IReadOnlyList<T> with AsElementOf: a tick loop, a debug menu and development-only cheats, in registration order, empty rather than missing, and local to their context. Plain C# with a runner component; includes EditMode tests.

Context.Inject on scene components: a scene context that builds in Awake and injects every component of its scene, a required [Inject] member and an [Inject(Optional = true)] one, and injection of objects spawned later. Includes EditMode tests.
